articles.title: SEC Commissioner Peirce counters views that crypto rule will foster synthetic tokens
articles.snippet: Hester Peirce, the commissioner behind the SEC's Crypto Task Force, made statements on the now-delayed proposal, perhaps tamping down mistaken beliefs.

articles.title: Why Minnesota is empowering local banks to fight Wall Street for crypto revenue
articles.snippet: A local banker told CoinDesk that in light of Wall Street’s aggressive push into the crypto industry, Minnesota's financial institutions could not afford to remain on the sidelines.

articles.title: Tom Emmer brushes off law enforcement concerns over Clarity Act
articles.snippet: House Majority Whip Tom Emmer said concerns from law enforcement groups about crypto developer protections are being overstated.

articles.title: Congress hits Polymarket and Kalshi with a massive insider trading probe
articles.snippet: Rep. James Comer is demanding internal records from the prediction market CEOs, warning that government employees could be using classified information to make “huge profits”.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin heads lower late Friday as Warsh takes over at Fed
articles.snippet: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chairman in a White House ceremony early Friday afternoon.
